evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-13"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-13". A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date is date-only (YYYY-MM-DD). A datetime string was rejected.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 {"dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 200 with the new date. PATCH {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null. The same worked on todo 3, changing it from 2026-12-01 to 2026-10-01 and then to null.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30" returned 400. POST with "14/10/2026" returned 400. POST with "2026-10-14T10:00:00" returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" returned 400. Each response body was {"error":"dueDate must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format"}.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-14 (UTC). I created todos with due dates yesterday, today, 2026-12-01, none, and 2026-01-01 (the last then marked done).
